_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a 3DO project can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A project is one or more disc images. The BIOS is asked for on the firmware page, according to the System Type setting.

slots.title: Discs
slots.help: 3DO disc images. Each can be a raw dump (.iso or .bin), a .cue file whose track files join the project automatically, or a .chd file. The first disc is in the drive when the machine starts. The order here is the order the Previous Disc and Next Disc inputs go through.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: The saved data the console starts with. A 3DO keeps saved games and its own settings in a small internal memory (NVRAM). This is the file that Emulator > Export Save Data... writes. Put it back under the same name, NVRAM.ram, to continue a run from where another one stopped. The file is never changed. The project and the movie record exactly which file it was, so a movie that starts from a saved game can be played back by anyone who has the same file. Leave it empty and the console starts with nothing saved.
